segments.text: LOrd, I am not hye minded: I haue no proud lookes.
I doe not exerciſe myſelf in great maters: whiche are to hye for me.
But I refrayne my ſoule, and kepe it low, like as a childe that is wayned from his mother: yea, my ſoule is euen as a wayned childe.
O Iſraell truſt in the Lorde: from this time furth, for euermore.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne. &c.
As it was in the beginning. &c. Amen.
